mapper.select: SELECT mrkt_idx_anly_tgt_cd , prdc_fulf_dt , prdc_inpt_mnmnc_dtl_cd , prdc_inpt_mnmnc_cd , expp_lvl_dtl_nm , expp_scre , prdc_rslt_ym , expp_lvl_nm , mnmnc_cd , expp_dir_symb_nm , expp_dir_synb_scre , expp_rnk , dir_rank FROM ( select OA.mrkt_idx_anly_tgt_cd /* 시장지수분석대상코드 */ , OA.mnmnc_cd /* MNEMONIC코드 예측대상값 */ , OA.prdc_fulf_dt /* 예측수행일자 */ , OA.prdc_rslt_ym /* 예측결과년월 */ , OA.prdc_inpt_mnmnc_cd /* 예측입력MNEMONIC코드 설명력상세차트출력대상변수 */ , MIN(OA.prdc_inpt_mnmnc_dtl_cd) AS prdc_inpt_mnmnc_dtl_cd /* 예측입력MNEMONIC코드 설명력상세차트출력대상변수 */ , MIN(OA.expp_lvl_nm) AS expp_lvl_nm /* 설명력레벨명 설명력산출변수 카테고리 */ , MIN(OA.expp_lvl_dtl_nm) AS expp_lvl_dtl_nm /* 설명력레벨상세명 설명력산출변수명 */ , AVG(OA.expp_scre) AS expp_scre /* 설명력점수 */ , SUM(OA.expp_dir_synb_scre) AS expp_dir_synb_scre /* 설명력방향 기준 점수 */ , OA.expp_dir_symb_nm AS expp_dir_symb_nm , OA.expp_rnk AS expp_rnk , CASE WHEN SUM(OA.expp_dir_synb_scre) = 1 THEN '+' WHEN SUM(OA.expp_dir_synb_scre) = -1 THEN '-' WHEN SUM(OA.expp_dir_synb_scre) = 0 THEN '0' END AS expp_dir_symn_nm /* 설명력방향 */ , RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY SUM(OA.expp_dir_synb_scre) ORDER BY AVG(OA.expp_scre) DESC) AS dir_rank from ( select a.mrkt_idx_anly_tgt_cd /* 시장지수분석대상코드 */ , a.mnmnc_cd /* MNEMONIC코드 예측대상값 */ , a.prdc_fulf_dt /* 예측수행일자 */ , a.prdc_rslt_dt /* 예측결과일자 */ , SUBSTR(a.prdc_rslt_dt, 1, 6) AS prdc_rslt_ym /* 예측결과년월 */ , a.prdc_inpt_mnmnc_cd /* 예측입력MNEMONIC코드 설명력상세차트출력대상변수 */ , a.prdc_inpt_mnmnc_dtl_cd /* 예측입력MNEMONIC코드 설명력상세차트출력대상변수 */ , a.expp_lvl_nm /* 설명력레벨명 설명력산출변수 카테고리 */ , a.expp_lvl_dtl_nm /* 설명력레벨상세명 설명력산출변수명 */ , a.expp_scre /* 설명력점수 */ , a.expp_rnk /* 설명력순위 점수기준 전체 순위 */ , a.expp_dir_symb_nm /* 설명력방향 */ , CASE WHEN a.expp_dir_symb_nm = '+' THEN 1 WHEN a.expp_dir_symb_nm = '-' THEN -1 WHEN a.expp_dir_symb_nm = '0' THEN 0 END AS expp_dir_synb_scre /* 설명력방향 기준 점수 */ from tmm_bztgtprdcexppinfom a where ${queryWhere} and a.expp_lvl_nm = #{explanatoryLevelNm} and a.del_yn = 'N' and a.expp_scre != 0 and a.expp_dir_symb_nm != '0' and a.prdc_fulf_dt = #{predictDate} and SUBSTR(a.prdc_rslt_dt, 1, 6) = #{date} ) OA GROUP BY OA.mrkt_idx_anly_tgt_cd, OA.mnmnc_cd, OA.prdc_fulf_dt, OA.prdc_rslt_ym, OA.prdc_inpt_mnmnc_cd ) OOA WHERE OOA.expp_dir_symn_nm = #{direction} ORDER BY expp_scre DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT tb.mrkt_idx_anly_tgt_cd , tb.prdc_fulf_dt , tb.mnmnc_cd , tb.prdc_inpt_mnmnc_cd , tb.expp_lvl_nm , tb.expp_dtl_cntt , tb.expp_lvl_dtl_nm FROM tmm_bztgtexppcnttd tb WHERE ${queryWhere} AND tb.del_yn = 'N' AND tb.expp_lvl_nm = expp_lvl_dtl_nm AND tb.expp_lvl_nm = #{explanatoryLevelNm} AND tb.prdc_fulf_dt = #{predictDate} LIMIT 1

SELECT tb.mrkt_idx_anly_tgt_cd , tb.prdc_fulf_dt , tb.mnmnc_cd , tb.prdc_inpt_mnmnc_cd , tb.expp_lvl_nm , tb.expp_dtl_cntt , tb.expp_lvl_dtl_nm FROM tmm_bztgtexppcnttd tb WHERE ${queryWhere} AND tb.del_yn = 'N' AND tb.expp_lvl_nm != expp_lvl_dtl_nm AND tb.expp_lvl_nm = #{explanatoryLevelNm} AND tb.prdc_fulf_dt = #{predictDate} AND tb.prdc_inpt_mnmnc_cd = #{predictionInputMnemonicCd} LIMIT 1

SELECT a.mrkt_idx_data_no , a.ric_cd , a.mnmnc_cd , b.instm_cltn_tbl_nm , b.instm_data_spt_cd , a.gds_data_src_no FROM tmm_mrktidxdatam a , tmm_mrktidxdatad b WHERE a.mrkt_idx_data_no = b.mrkt_idx_data_no AND a.del_yn = b.del_yn AND a.del_yn = 'N' AND b.mrkt_idx_anly_tgt_cd = #{marketIndexAnalysisTargetCd} AND (a.ric_cd = #{predictionInputMnemonicDetailCd} OR a.mnmnc_cd = #{predictionInputMnemonicDetailCd}) LIMIT 1
